summary: This study demonstrates the use of atomic layer chemical vapor deposition (ALCVD) to grow epitaxial TiO2 thin films at low temperatures using titanium tetraiodide (TiI4) and hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) as precursors. The study investigates the phase formation, epitaxial relationships, and growth behavior of rutile and anatase phases on different substrates such as a-Al2O3 and MgO.
evidence: This study demonstrates that atomic layer chemical vapor deposition is an excellent technique for growing epitaxial TiO2 thin films at low temperatures. Using TiI4 and H2O2 as precursors, both the rutile and anatase phases could be deposited.
